_comment: FOUR GUNPOWDER PRESSED INTO ONE COMPACT (#278, owner 2026-08-21).
The same 2x2 press as the Blaze Briquette, and for the same mechanical reason: a cooking
recipe consumes exactly one item, so four powder cannot feed the Sintering Kiln directly.
Gunpowder because a solid propellant grain IS compacted powder - that is how a rocket motor
and an airbag inflator are both built, and both exist to release a burst of gas. It also
needs no new find: creepers are weight 100 in the demolition yard, so the feedstock is
already renewable and this becomes a competing sink against TNT rather than a free one.
Net cost is one gunpowder per Wind Charge, since vanilla turns the rod it makes into four.
